name: ano_step_benzene
purpose: TASKS 300, GoalGathering/notes/PreRegistration_2026-11-25_ANO_Step_Benzene.md with amendment 1 (the user, 25 Nov 2026: 'Eerst de ANO-proef', 'Ja, bereid voor'): benzene's DF-MP2 Hessian rows at the corpus geometry for every target basis of the composite's MP2 step in the registration (cc-pVDZ, cc-pVTZ control, cc-pVQZ, roos-ano-tz, ano-pVQZ from a Basis Set Exchange file through PSIPATH, cc-pwCVTZ frozen-core and all-electron) and the DF-SCF rows at cc-pVTZ and cc-pVQZ for the basis-set-limit recipe; check W on water for both theories as the smoke; one row of each ANO set repeated with cc-pV5Z fitting sets. Upstream calls: psi4 tests/dfmp2-grad1 and dfmp2-grad5 (DF-MP2 gradient, against findif), tests/cbs-xtpl-gradient (gradient('SCF/…')), tests/psithon2 (PSIPATH); no upstream test makes a DF-MP2 gradient with fitting sets of another name than the orbital basis's, hence the cc-pV5Z rows

estimate.basis: rough: benzene's DF-MP2 rows took 19 s at cc-pVTZ and 100 s at cc-pVQZ per row at 8 threads on 10 Nov (probes/results_m1/anchor_oop_dfmp2.log); the full plan has more rows than that run's two; ano-pVQZ has cc-pVQZ's 510 functions with far more primitives and the cc-pV5Z fitting rows are heavier, both unmeasured; nine row sets and two single rows, with margin

memory.basis: a bound: probes/wsl_capped.sh stops the run at 10240 MB; psi4 is given 8 GB; measured peak RSS 5.48 GB at benzene DF-MP2/cc-pVQZ (510 functions) on 10 Nov; the ANO and cc-pV5Z-fitting rows are unmeasured and the lane states each label's peak
